title: Expectations in patients undergoing a back surgery
summary:
Pain is a normal consequence after any surgical intervention. However the intensity and duration of the experienced pain varies immensely between individuals. 
As treatment expectancy has been demonstrated as one potential modulator for treatment outcomes, one being pain, this study aims to investigate the expectancies of patients undergoing spinal surgery. Questionnaires aimed to evaluate expectations, self-efficacy and pain will be used before as well as 2 and 4 days after surgery and at a 3 month follow up.
conditions: Diagnoses which lead to spine surgery
